# A package with a static assets path keeps serving its files from its own
# routes file, and its path method lives on the hub under the package's
# namespace, so another package can link to the asset.

muxt generate
muxt check
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./site

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": {},
		"example.com/m/blog": {
			"input_static_assets_directory": "assets",
			"output_static_assets_path": "/static"
		}
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /admin Dashboard()").Parse(`<link id="css" rel="stylesheet" href="{{$.Path.Blog.ReadStatic}}app.css">`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- blog/assets/app.css --
p{color:red}
-- site/site_test.go --
package site

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"regexp"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m/admin"
	"example.com/m/blog"
)

func TestAdminLinksToBlogAsset(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	admin.TemplateRoutes(mux, admin.Server{})
	blog.TemplateRoutes(mux, blog.Server{})

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/admin", nil))
	if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("GET /admin status = %d, want %d", got, http.StatusOK)
	}
	match := regexp.MustCompile(`href="([^"]+)"`).FindStringSubmatch(rec.Body.String())
	if match == nil {
		t.Fatalf("GET /admin body = %q, want an href", rec.Body.String())
	}

	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, match[1], nil))
	if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", match[1], got, http.StatusOK)
	}
	if got, want := rec.Body.String(), "p{color:red}\n"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want %q", match[1], got, want)
	}
}
